notes.title: Item rebalance and Voice Lines added to Scout!
notes.content:
Another quick update adding logic around icons so that item tiers can be dynamically set at start up... But you don't care about that what you do care about is that this allows items to be balanced much better!

Also another Voice actress joined the crew and Scouts lines are done!

notes.title: Added Voice to Our Pilots
notes.content: It has been a long time comming but we finally have voices for most of our pilots! The best way you can support the project is to try the playtest and give feedback on steps forward!

notes.title: UI Update! Indicaator added to notify you that you hit an opponent
notes.content:
With the emphasis on combat in the game I added a feature to notify you when your attack on an opponent was successful

https://www.reddit.com/r/IndieDev/comments/176puok/added_a_visual_indicator_when_hitting_opponents/

notes.title: UI Update: Map select previews map
notes.content: Just a simple UI update to give players a better experience while picking what map to race on.

notes.title: Update notes for 30th September 2023
notes.content: added a servey options for playtestes to get feedback on the state of the game.
